summary: Independently reproduced all three review counterexamples at candidate commit cace24273ede0742f57b4ef6d716485384721a9b. Corrected lossless MLIR pass-option quoting for double-quote and backslash paths, and discovered validated ROCm roots through resolved arbitrary private-bin ld.lld symlinks while preserving the candidate's precedence and diagnostics.

tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate failing-before reproduction in the actual gpu-module-to-binary path; lld invocation failed.

Corrected focused regressions and backend coverage; 22 passed.

Corrected real compilation and gfx950 numerical execution; maximum error 0.00e+00 against Torch a + b.
PATH-only discovery selected the resolved validated toolkit, compiled and ran with maximum error 0.00e+00, and emitted 4,227-byte gfx950 ISA with vecAddKernel_0 and s_endpgm.
Complete corrected unit suite; 1109 passed and 17 skipped.

gpu_execution.evidence: Quote-root, backslash-root, and arbitrary-PATH cases each ran vector add on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950 with max error 0.00e+00. The PATH-only run emitted 4,227-byte ISA naming gfx950 and vecAddKernel_0 and containing s_endpgm.

remaining_limitations: The reported gfx1250 GPU and ROCm 6 environment were unavailable; hardware execution and toolkit compatibility there remain unverified.
GPU and ISA validation used the assigned gfx950 GPU with ROCm 7.2.
A textual MLIR pass option cannot losslessly represent a value containing both single and double quote characters; this case now raises a precise ValueError before compilation.
No native rebuild was required because the correction changes Python only; validation used the prepared pinned native extension and LLVM.
